decisions.rationale: Stage A exact original description anchor reused; no re-keyed research span identifiers
Separate JSON Pointer field value reference, frozen source semantic SHA and canonical JSON field/value hashes
Exact, possibly overlapping original spans and explicit qualifier context; no invented heading or forced sentence split
Board tags alone may not produce mandatory employer qualifications
Separate category, required/preferred/unresolved strength, negative cue and conditional alternative scope
Source-supported DAG with any_of and all_of, leaves bound to conditional qualification items and qualifier anchors
Many-to-many item relations, source-bound candidate separate from linguistic meaning check; legacy v2 field remains item-unmapped
Persian original evidence cannot be injected into unversioned English-only v30 semantic artifact
Existing accepted row does not prove independent review of each employer fact
Orthogonal original integrity, target relation, linguistic fidelity, semantic reviewer provenance and downstream permission
No B1 database migration; B6 requires separate source-identity/rollback approval
New projection version only if B3 proves necessary; v2 artifact immutability protected
Candidate-only source-anchored view, unknowns separate, no Market/Capability/Work/Registry reuse
Owner delegated routine review; assistant prior-context exposure must be labeled and not impersonate blind human
B5 must use frozen B0 6-8 job protocol, not the exposed A1 development examples
Original item interpretation and board-field conflict candidate only; no provider calls by default

json_pointer_hardening: Reject noncanonical array indices and malformed RFC6901 escape sequences
known_limitations: B1 schema proves shape/reference invariants, not employer-intent interpretation
real A1 source examples are exposed and assistant-reviewed with prior context, not holdouts
legacy English projection v2 still does not establish item translation meaning
all source-bound translation targets in B1 examples are synthetic design constructs only
B2 source segmentation quality, B3 local model fidelity, B4 usefulness, B5 fresh evaluation and B6 promotion not implemented
review_dimension_hardening: Semantic classification approval requires review event with dimension semantic_classification; source integrity or translation association events cannot substitute
